acceptance: The owner chose a replacement roster, recorded here with the evidence from omp's 19.x model catalog.
make omp-candidate-check VERSION=<19.x> passes model-catalog and the live checks on the owner's darwin-arm64 Mac.
A pin PR to omp 19.x merges with owner evidence and a hosted SHIP.
description:
Every omp release after 18.20.0 fails BenchBox's candidate check: 18.21.0, 18.22.0-18.22.2, 19.0.0 and 19.0.1 (daily omp-pin-bump runs red since 2026-11-17, e.g. run 44750794955). In each, model-catalog fails because the catalog no longer lists google-antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash, google-antigravity/claude-sonnet-5-5, google-antigravity/claude-opus-5-5 and google-antigravity/gemini-4-argon, which .github/review-omp-config.yml routes to. Owner decision 2026-11-20: pin 18.20.0 now and move the roster later as a separate decision.

Work: find what replaced those models in omp 19.x (provider rename, new model ids, or removal), propose a roster change with the review-depth and capacity implications (docs/internal and _project/decisions on reviewer models), get the owner's choice, then change .github/review-omp-config.yml and any fixtures, re-run the gateway so clients are allowed the new models, and let the pin-bump workflow propose 19.x. Changes to the roster are soundness-path changes under the review gate.
